We've reached the guys switching teams portion of the scrimmage. Jabari Walker and Caleb Love now on the blue team with LeBron, Maxey and KCP. Brown, Edgecombe and Dean Wade on White with Philon and Hukporti. 

First look at some lineup combo experimentation.
